repeated_proposals.note: Some faces have dust upon them. It repeats the section's 80:40 scene of an adverse layer lying upon the face.
Darkness covers those dust-marked faces. It repeats the facial covering that the section reads alongside عَلَيْهِم in 1:7.
The dust-and-darkness faces are identified as the disbelieving, wicked people. It completes the two preceding facial marks with their adverse group.
